name: harness-doc
title: Harness Documentation
description: Create or update evidence-grounded feature doc sets, onboarding, and troubleshooting guides. Use /harness-doc or /hn-doc with list or upsert. Overlaps with architecture-decision-records on design rationale and the office-documents reference on document output; owns reader-oriented guides, with a final Humanizer pass followed by validation. No harness initialization or publication is implied.
author: wzlwit

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Omitted means read-only listing. Create and update are aliases for upsert.

inputs.name: feature
inputs.description: Feature, existing doc set, or focused authoring request; required for upsert unless clear from the conversation.

inputs.name: audience
inputs.description: Reuse the established audience or clarify it. Partner access does not imply public disclosure.

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Explicit documentation destination. Otherwise reuse the coding repository's documentation convention, then docs/guides/<feature> when no convention exists.
